description: Synthetic routing cases derived from the current engineering-harness policy. Expected labels are policy expectations, not measured model or runtime skill-activation evidence.

cases.question: Add a required device_id check to the existing POST /v1/readers/heartbeat handler; the request contract is already accepted.
cases.context: Backend service written in Go, not Rust/Axum. Single handler plus its test. Cause not applicable.

cases.question: Change the uniqueness key of attendance event rows; it is undecided whether duplicates are per device+card or per device+card+day, and the migration rewrites existing rows.
cases.context: Schema, migration and data-integrity semantics. The owner has not confirmed the key.

cases.question: Apply the approved spacing and column order from the accepted dashboard design to the attendance summary table.
cases.context: Design already approved in the record. No open design, flow or accessibility judgment; localized SolidJS presentation fix.

cases.question: Design the empty and error states of the new parent notification history screen; the flow and wording are not decided.
cases.context: Material unresolved UX judgment. No frontend implementation has been accepted yet.

cases.question: The attendance sync endpoint intermittently returns HTTP 500 after the nightly job; the log has a stack trace but the cause is not established.
cases.context: Unknown-cause defect. No evidence yet identifies the failing code path. A speculative patch is not allowed before debugging.

cases.question: Fix the off-by-one in the session window end: the failing test and the log already show window_end is computed before the timezone shift; change that expression.
cases.context: Cause is established by evidence, so the remaining work is implementation-only. Debugger is optional under policy.

cases.question: Fix the typo recieve to receive in one code comment of a single file.
cases.context: Standalone mechanical edit with no behavior change and no delegated implementation in progress. Main may edit directly; a worker is also a policy-valid choice.

cases.question: Add a --dry-run flag to the local install helper script and document it in its README.
cases.context: Tooling, script and docs outside frontend and backend. Implementation needed with a focused check.

cases.question: The backend worker finished the attendance finalization state-machine change across three modules; independent verification is requested before merge.
cases.context: Business-critical state machine and multi-module change. The rules are already confirmed. Worker evidence exists but is not independent.

cases.question: Review the change that moves session token storage from plain config to hashed storage before the branch is integrated.
cases.context: Security and auth-sensitive change; implementation is complete and main flags it as a material risk.

cases.question: Rename a private helper variable inside one function; focused unit tests passed and the user did not ask for review.
cases.context: Localized behavior-preserving change with credible worker or local test evidence. No risk trigger is present.

cases.question: Two reasonable fixes for the cache-invalidation race failed and the team still disagrees on the root cause.
cases.context: Credible unresolved disagreement after two failed fix attempts. Oracle is an exceptional escalation; debugger evidence may precede it.

cases.question: Which of the three services owns the SMS retry queue? The repository has no notes and the owner is unknown.
cases.context: Location and dependency surface unknown. Scout answers where, not why.

cases.question: The user cited the exact file src/handlers/readers.go and function parseHeartbeat; add a missing length check.
cases.context: Exact location is supplied, so Scout is not needed. Implementation only.

cases.question: The accepted contract sets the late threshold to 08:15; update the existing constant and its test.
cases.context: School policy is confirmed in the accepted contract with no open state-machine question. The word attendance alone does not make a domain specialist necessary.

cases.question: For optional lunch absences on a half-day schedule, it is not decided whether the student is recorded as half-day or absent.
cases.context: Attendance business rule unresolved and not confirmed by the school. Main must not invent the policy; no writes until a decision exists.

cases.question: Provider callbacks can arrive after an SMS retry; it is not decided whether a duplicate SMS to a parent must be suppressed within 24 hours.
cases.context: Messaging delivery and retry semantics are unresolved.

cases.question: Add a CSV export of student and parent contact numbers for the office; retention and minimization for the export are not decided.
cases.context: Student and parent personal data export with an unresolved privacy and retention policy.

cases.question: The frontend team asked for a grade_level field in the backend attendance API response; the field is in the accepted contract.
cases.context: Backend-only API implementation against an accepted contract. The word frontend names the consumer, not the work, so no frontend guidance is needed.

cases.question: Push the feature branch and open a pull request against master for the harness changes.
cases.context: The request grants no explicit push, PR or merge authority for this scope. Readiness alone does not grant it.

cases.question: The user explicitly authorized publishing candidate-0001 to the destination named in the ship packet.
cases.context: Exact candidate, version, destination and operation authority are present, with fresh evidence attached.

cases.question: The user says stop while a background backend worker is running on the attendance fix.
cases.context: A user stop is authoritative. Main launches nothing new; pause or cancel only through explicit worker controls.

cases.question: Queue this: after the current fix, add a short operations note to the manual.
cases.context: A queue request records order and acknowledges only. No launch or implementation until the item is scheduled.
